# A name a target reserves is renamed, and a test still reaches it by the
# name the program wrote: `c.range` reads the var and `c.go.click()` clicks
# the node, on every target a test executes on.
#
# testdata/reserved_names.txtar is the code; this is the answer. `main` is
# the component under test, so its declarations reach each target under the
# names written here rather than an instance's copies of them.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

[!gtk4] stop 'gtk4 needs its development libraries to build'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok   2 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

struct Item {
    type  string
    class int
}

func bump(m int, fmt int, class int) int {
    var cmds = m + fmt
    var msg = cmds + class
    return msg
}

func longest(len int, xs list[int]) int {
    return len + xs.length
}

component main node {
    var range = 1
    var chan = 2
    var m = 3
    var cmd = 4
    var object = 5
    var width = 6
    var it = Item{type="a", class=1}
    func add(state int) {
        object = object + state
    }
    vbox {
        button #go(text="go {range} {chan} {m} {cmd} {object} {width} {it.type}", @click {
            range = bump(range, cmd, chan)
            m = m + 1
            add(1)
            width = longest(width, [1, 2])
            it = Item{type="b", class=it.class + 1}
        })
    }
}

func testStartsFromItsInitializers(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.range == 1)
    t.assert(c.object == 5)
    t.assert(c.it.type == "a")
}

func testClickReachesTheRenamed(t Test, c main) {
    c.go.click()
    t.assert(c.range == 7)
    t.assert(c.m == 4)
    t.assert(c.object == 6)
    t.assert(c.width == 8)
    t.assert(c.it.type == "b")
    t.assert(c.it.class == 2)
}
